pages.name: Dashboard / home
pages.description: Default landing page after login. Shows the user's open orders, recent activity, and a global search.

pages.name: Orders list
pages.description: Filterable, sortable table of every order the user has access to. Supports bulk actions for power users.

pages.name: Order detail
pages.description: Full order record — line items, customer, shipping, status timeline, audit trail. Read-heavy, occasional high-stakes writes (refund, cancel).

pages.name: Customer detail
pages.description: Customer record with order history, contact details, and notes. Used by support to triage tickets.

pages.name: Admin — user management
pages.description: Provision and de-provision internal users, assign roles, view audit log of permission changes.

pages.name: Mobile pickup screen
pages.description: Mobile-first screen used by warehouse staff to confirm order pickup. Tolerates intermittent connectivity.
